subagents.name: ui_ux_architect
subagents.description: Specialized UI/UX Design & Human Factors Architect subagent. Audits and crafts mobile-first, bilingual (Hebrew RTL / English LTR) design systems, Micro-Interactions, WCAG 2.2 AAA accessibility, Glassmorphism, and frictionless onboarding flows.

subagents.name: developer
subagents.description: Specialized Software Developer subagent. Implements modular, decoupled components following Clean Architecture and co-locates unit tests.

subagents.name: code_reviewer
subagents.description: Specialized Peer Code Reviewer subagent. Audits code deltas for Big-O complexity, memory leak prevention, async race conditions, and N+1 database queries.

subagents.name: security_auditor
subagents.description: Specialized Enterprise Security Auditor subagent. Audits changes against OWASP ASVS Level 3 and OWASP API Top 10 (Zero-Trust, BOLA/BFLA, ReDoS, SSRF, Dual-Key Rate Limiting, Crypto).

subagents.name: adversarial_pentester
subagents.description: Adversarial Security Pentester / Red Team Auditor subagent. Systematically executes controlled offensive attack simulations, attempts access control bypasses (BOLA/BFLA), prototype pollution, XSS injection, and ReDoS starvation in a sandbox, and outputs a formal Vulnerability & Threat Assessment Report.

subagents.name: perf_chaos_engineer
subagents.description: Specialized Performance, Web Vitals & Chaos Stress Engineer subagent. Tests high-load package queries, memory benchmarks, offline service worker resilience, and Lighthouse 100/100 Core Web Vitals (LCP < 800ms, INP < 50ms, CLS 0).

subagents.name: qa_verifier
subagents.description: Specialized QA and Build Verification subagent. Executes static analysis, multi-tier testbenches, anti-facade fault injection, and production builds.
